meta.name: inclusive-design
meta.description: Use when working on inclusion, i18n/localization, global name/address forms, low-end devices, slow/metered networks, affordability, or first-time/low-confidence users; not WCAG/screen readers (see accessibility).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计包容不同用户、地区与设备的体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让产品覆盖更多元化的用户
copy.tagline_en: Design inclusive experiences for diverse users, regions, and devices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to serve a wider, more diverse user base

howto.what: 当用户请求评估产品或设计的包容性时，Claude会从语言文化、设备网络、认知负荷、身份认同和偏见识别五个维度逐一分析，指出可能存在的排斥假设，并提供改进方向。
howto.when: 当用户提到包容性、国际化、低端设备、首次用户等话题，或要求进行包容性审查、设计全球表单时。

say.text: 帮我评估这个注册表单的包容性。
say.note: Claude会按五个维度分析表单的排斥点。

say.text: 如何降低我的App对网络带宽的要求？
say.note: Claude会给出低端设备友好的建议。

howto.what_en: When asked to evaluate the inclusivity of a product or design, Claude analyzes five dimensions: language/culture, device/network, cognitive load, identity, and bias recognition, identifying assumptions that may exclude people and suggesting improvements.
howto.when_en: When the user mentions inclusion, internationalization, low-end devices, first-time users, or requests an inclusion review, global form design, etc.

say_en.text: Evaluate the inclusivity of this registration form.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes for exclusion points across five dimensions.

say_en.text: How can I reduce my app's bandwidth requirements?
say_en.note: Claude suggests low-end device friendly approaches.
